instructions.question: Does this comment express warm support or relief, clear hostility or distress, or neither?
instructions.rule: Neutral is the default: calm or reasoned questions, corrections, arguments and policy demands (even indignant ones), statistics, dry irony, jokes, teasing of tagged friends, town-ranking banter and mild regret. Negative needs a strong marker: figures called faked, copied or suspicious, sarcastic 'under control', partisan jabs, insults or swearing, strong exasperation, grim forecasts, or denial slogans. Positive covers thanks, praise, blessings, encouragement, caring advice, and sincere relief that cases are falling.

neutral.what: Calm or reasoned questions, corrections, arguments, policy demands, statistics, anecdotes, irony, teasing friends, banter, mild regret.
examples: Sa keq, numri kaq i larte [What a pity, such a high number]
Etrit Sinani ti po mshefesh spo kallxon qe e ki [Etrit, you're hiding it, not telling that you have it]
neutral.cues: a/pse (questions), duhet (should), ju lutem (please), lshoi bajrakun (dropped the flag), prin (leads), hahaha, tagged names
neutral.not_for: Suspicion that figures are faked, partisan jabs, swearing, grim outbursts (negative).

positive.what: Thanks, praise, congratulations, sincere prayers, encouragement, caring advice, relief or hope about falling cases.
examples: Dje 82 sot 75 po vjen tu ra numri [Yesterday 82, today 75, the number is falling]
Urime të Sheruarve! [Congratulations to the recovered!]
Rip covid 19. [RIP covid 19.]
positive.cues: urime (congratulations), ju lumt (well done), hallall (well deserved), zoti e sheroft (God heal), po bie numri (number falling), zbut (eased)
positive.not_for: Jokey 'ishalla' or 'ma gjall' cheering, greetings to tagged friends, jokes about why cases fell (neutral).

negative.what: Suspicion of faked figures, sarcasm at officials, partisan jabs, insults, swearing, strong exasperation, grim forecasts, denial.
examples: Dje 226 sod 224 mos jeni tja bo copy paste. [Yesterday 226, today 224, are you copy-pasting?]
A boni teste pa libreze partie? [Do you test without a party card?]
Kjo me duket pak e dyshimt ne gjakove dje 2 e sot 15 . [This looks suspicious to me, Gjakova yesterday 2, today 15.]
Tmerr valla,po lëvizin pa masa mbrojtëse dhe në grupe! [Horror, they move around unprotected and in groups!]
negative.cues: copy paste, dyshimt (suspicious), rrena (lies), nën kontroll (sarcastic), interesa (interests), tmerr (horror), marre (shame), bollni ma (enough already)
negative.not_for: Reasoned critiques, calm doubts, corrections and playful jokes (neutral).
